# spydersoftidentity_identity_resource (Resource)

An identity resource (a group of user claims, such as profile or email). Import with the resource name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spydersoftidentity_identity_resource" "example" {
  name         = "example-profile"
  display_name = "Example profile"

  user_claims = ["name", "nickname"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique identity resource name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description shown on the consent screen.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown on the consent screen.
- `emphasize` (Boolean) Emphasize on the consent screen.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the identity resource is enabled.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom key/value properties.
- `required` (Boolean) Cannot be deselected on the consent screen.
- `show_in_discovery_document` (Boolean) Whether it is listed in the discovery document.
- `user_claims` (Set of String) User claim types in this identity resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by identity resource name.
terraform import spydersoftidentity_identity_resource.example example-profile
```
